usage: The word 電車 (din6 ce1) is used as a noun to refer to a tram or streetcar.
It often takes measure words like 部 (bou6) when counting, e.g., 一部電車 (jat1 bou6 din6 ce1).
You can use 電車 in simple present tense sentences to talk about commuting, e.g., 我坐電車返工 (I take the tram to work).
It can be combined with places to indicate routes, like 電車站 (tram stop) or 電車線 (tram line).
